name: senzacoreutils
description: Javascript partial port of GNU Coreutils.

scripts.build-fs-worker: npx webpack --mode 'production' --config 'fs-worker.webpack.config.cjs' --stats-error-details; for _app in evm-contract-call evm-contract-deployment-address evm-contract-deployment-abi evm-contract-deployment-bytecode evm-contract-deployment-compiler-output evm-contract-deployment-deployment-networks evm-contract-deployment-versions evm-contract-deployments-dir evm-contracts-tools; do cp 'fs-worker.js' "dist/${_app}"; cp 'fs-worker.js' "dist/lib${_app}" || true; done
scripts.build-lib: for _app in sha256sum; do npm run "build-lib${_app}"; done
scripts.build-bin: for _app in sha256sum; do npm run "build-${_app}"; done
scripts.build: npm run lint; npm run build-fs-worker; npm run build-lib; npm run build-bin
scripts.publish-npm: npm run build-man && npm run build && npm publish --access public
